description: Route-safety baseline. Pre-existing heuristic candidates for the route-safety guard. Findings listed here are KNOWN and do NOT fail CI. Triage candidates live in docs/security/route-safety-backlog.md. Regenerate with: node scripts/security/route-safety-scan.mjs --baseline

findings.reason: Route exports a mutating handler (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) that performs a Prisma write but has no getServerSession/getToken/verifyAdminFromDb auth gate and is not a legit-exception (auth/webhook/[token]/test-helper) route.

Route exports a mutating handler (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) that performs a Prisma write but has no getServerSession/getToken/verifyAdminFromDb auth gate and is not a legit-exception (auth/webhook/[token]/test-helper) route.

Auth-entry route: establishes auth by minting the portal JWT, so it cannot itself be session-gated. Writes only lastLoginAt on a successful bcrypt compare, and is rate-limited (10 requests / 15 min). Carried as a visible baseline entry rather than a path exemption.

KNOWN WEAKNESS — NOT a clean exception. Auth-entry route that sets a new password keyed only on knowing the account email, with no emailed verification code, then returns a valid portal JWT. Rate limiting is not verification. Deliberately baselined (visible) rather than path-exempted (invisible) so it stays on the triage list. Fix: require an expiring single-use emailed reset token before the write. See docs/security/route-safety-backlog.md.
